data: Found in the necropolis of Passo Marinaro (Camarina).

An outstanding collection of archaeological material. The collection ranges from Siracusa and the surrounding territory (Megara Hyblaia, Akrai, Kasmenai etc) to encompass all of eastern Sicily, reaching as far as Gela and Agrigento. The ground floor covers prehistory through to the end of the Classical period. Upstairs includes Hellenistic and Roman Syracuse and a display of material from the catacombs. A gallery displaying material from Hellenistic eastern Sicily is in preparation.

  • Text after Dubois

translation

Ceux qui suivent sont inscrits (dans le plomb) pour qu'ils échouent : (liste des individus maudits). Que tous ceux-ci soient exsangues, malheureux soient-ils. (Dubois)

English translation

Those who follow are written (in lead) so that they fail: [list of names]. May all these be exsanguinated, and may they be miserable.

commentary

L'anomalie dans l'écriture serpentine 1. 3 est vraisemblablement le signe d'un changement de rubrique: les deux premières lignes et les trois dernières contiennent la malédiction, les lignes 3-26 la liste des individus maudits. (Dubois)
